content: Mawarite tukita timieme
Merikɨtsɨ Yawé Muitsexi katiniutaxatɨani, mɨpaɨ rehɨawetɨ:
«'Ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ ketiniwaruta'aitɨa mawari mekenetsi'atɨirieni. Kaneuyewekani memi'atɨanikɨ yunaitɨ kemɨ'ane mɨpaɨ mɨtiwakuyuitɨwani.
Mawarite neminaki'erie pɨhɨkɨtɨni: huru tepɨayari, pɨrata, wurunitse,
muxa 'ixurikiyari mɨyɨtsikimaɨyekɨ mu'uarietɨka meta kwimɨxetakɨ metatsiere mɨxetakɨ, rinu 'ixurikiyari witsimɨ'anene, kapura huxarieya 'ɨkariyari,
muxa 'uki nawiyarieya xetamekɨ 'uarietɨkaime, nawi 'aixɨa mɨ'anene, 'akatsiya kɨyeyari,
huriwa hatseitiyari kɨxeme hetsiemieme, witsimɨtiu'ɨatɨka witsitiyu'ɨariyame hatseiti mɨtiyupata meta 'ɨkwa witsimu'ɨa,
'unitse teteyari, meta hipame tetexi witsimɨ'anene mawari wewiwame kamixaya 'etsimɨnena hetsie meuyaxe meta kuka mekatɨni hetsiemieme.
Meta tuki xepɨnetsitawewirieni, xehamatɨa nemuyeikanikɨ.
Tuki xemɨtawewieni naitɨ pɨtiyepika kenemɨmatixeitsitɨani mɨpaɨ ti'aneneme.
Kakuni
»Kakuni keneutawewi 'akatsiya kɨyeyarikɨ, xeimeturuyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari tewime, haika tewiyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari 'atayeume meta yaxeikɨata mɨpaɨ 'utewime.
Huru kenewakuwiri taɨtana meta herie, meta hurukɨ kenatatenitɨa.
Keneutiwewi naukame huru hanirayari 'ɨkateyatsie keneu'uitɨaxɨa, 'etsatana huhutatɨ kana'uixɨamɨkɨ.
Kurumawime 'akatsiya kɨyeyari keneutiwewi, huru keneutiwiri.
Kɨyexi mukurumawi haniratsie keneuye'uitɨaxɨa kakuni 'etsatana mukumanetsie, mukukweiyanenikɨ.
Mɨpaɨ reheikame keneuhayewa pepɨkahenuyehapanani,
mana pepikamana 'inɨari niukiyari nemɨmatsiyetuirieni.
»Hurukɨ xeikɨa wewiyakame keneutawewi kanamikiyari Kakaɨyari ma'axeni, xeimeturuyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari tewime meta haika tewiyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari 'atayeume,
Kakaɨyari teɨtamete yuhutame hurukɨ pepɨwatiwewieni, titsunamekɨ mewewiyatɨkaime, kanamikitsie Kakaɨyari ma'axeni 'etsimeuyeyeutsie mema'uni.
'Etsimeuyeyeutsie mepu'uni Kakaɨyari teɨtamete. Mewetɨkaime meyuxewime keniwarayeitɨa Kakaɨyari ma'axeni.
»Kakaɨyari teɨtamete Kakaɨyari ma'axe heimana mepuye'anatɨkani, kɨmana mepenukanaka. Mepanuyutaxeiyani Kakaɨyari ma'axe meheukanenieretɨ.
»Kanamiki kenanukamana kakunitsie, manata kenekamana 'inɨari niukiyari nemɨmatsiyetuirieni.
Ne mana nepɨ'axeni Kakaɨyari teɨtamete wahixɨapa kakuni heima. Mana ne yanepɨmatikɨhɨaweni naime 'ɨkitɨarika pemɨwakuxaxatɨwanikɨ 'ixaheritsixi.
'Akatsiya mexayari
»'Akatsiya kɨyeyarikɨ mexa keneutawewi, nauka tewiyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari tewime meta huta tewiyari heimana 'auxɨwi 'atayeume meta haika tewiyari heimana tamamata 'aweme.
Huru keneukawiri, hurukɨtsiere tenimeyaritsie kenata'utɨa.
Xeitewiyari tsenitimeturuyari 'atayeume kenata'utɨa meta tenimeyari kenatawewi 'auriena hurukɨ.
»Naukame huru hanirayari keneutiwewi mexatsiemieme, xexuime keneu'uitɨaxɨa tsikurieyatsie, ma'ɨkatɨkatsie.
Hanira, mexa tenimeyari 'aurie pukumaneni, mana kɨyexi muye'unikɨ mɨkɨtɨkienenikɨ.
»Mɨkɨ kɨyexi mukurumawi 'akatsiya kɨyexiyari pɨhɨkɨtɨni, huru wiriyarietɨkaitɨ.
Xakɨrɨte, 'itɨte, hurukɨ xeikɨa pɨwewiyatɨkani meta tekɨxite, xarite 'amɨnene winu mawariyari tu'ame.
Mexatsie paa yapepɨramanani, nehɨxie yamɨtixuawenikɨ.
Kɨxeme 'uitɨwame
»Kɨxeme 'uitɨwame hurukɨ keneutawewi, titsunamekɨ wewiyakame. Hetsiena maweni, 'ɨkayari, muwatixaxawa, tuturi yu'iwitsi hexeiyame, tuturiyari yuxewiriyatɨ xeikɨa payani.
'Ataxewime yumamate pexeiyani, tapa haikatɨ tapata haikatɨ.
Xexuime mamateyaritsie haikakɨa puwatixaxawani 'arimetɨra tuturiyari hepaɨ tiyuxexeiyatɨ, tuturi yu'iwitsiyari hexeiyakame meta xawariyari.
Kɨxeme 'uitɨwame peixeiyanita nauka tekɨxiyari 'arimetɨra tuturiyari hepaɨ 'aneneme, meta yuxawari hexeiyatɨkaime.
Xexuitɨ mamateyari peixeiyani xexuime tekɨxi hixɨata, 'ɨkayari mɨrawiyatɨkatsie.
Tekɨxite meta mamateyari puyuxewiriyani kɨxeme 'uitɨwame hamatɨa, huru xeikɨa pɨhɨkɨtɨni titsunamekɨ wewiyakame.
»Keneutiwewiri 'atahuta kɨxemeyari, muwa keneuka'uitɨa yuhɨxie heuyekɨxeme.
Tepɨa hiru xikame kɨxeme hetsiemieme meta tɨɨ yayatsame, huru xeikɨa pɨhɨkɨtɨni.
Mɨkɨ kɨxeme 'uitɨwame mɨtawewierekɨ meta tinaitɨ mɨreukapinire huru xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana haika kiruyari kaniyɨmɨkɨ.
»Kenematiuxeiyatsitɨa hɨritsie yemekɨ mɨpaɨ ti'aneneme ketineutiwewi.
